quest.title: To Make Cat Ornaments
quest.description: Ooshima Junpei, who works at the Asase Shrine, seems to be bothered by something...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Traveler, you're here! Did you come to pay respects?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Oh, I'd say that I'm doing fine. I still need to fix the dimensions of the carvings, though.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: According to my initial thoughts, these carvings should fit snugly in a person's palm.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: That way, they can play with it easily.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Also, other than the carvings themselves, I think I should make some decorations.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I've seen that when people make these carvings, they will also add some accessories on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Things like flowers, animals, bases that have flowery patterns, things like that...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I'd also like to put such decorative bases on my wood carvings. That said, due to sizing issues, we can only put one ornament on one wood carving...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: But I'm thinking that if the decorations are detachable, I can just put on whatever decorations my customers request.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I'd probably want to start from simpler decorations... Something like Naku Weed.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: So, Traveler, could you help me gather 3 stalks of Naku Weed back to use for reference?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Sorry, Traveler, but I'll be leaving this in your hands. Come back and look for me once you have those Naku Weeds.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: If I can get three, I can view them in three different states.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: That way, I should be able to carve the best Naku Weed that I can.

talks.objective: Give Ooshima Junpei three Naku Weed

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Have you gotten those Naku Weeds?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Oh, nice! These should do the trick. Thank you so much, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Now, time to do a little investigating. How are we going to carve wood into the shape of Naku Weed...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: If I can make these decorations well enough and have a wide enough variety of them...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Maybe we'll be able to sell them separately...
